verdict: A near-identical rebuild of the Main Page, with every block, wrap and image in place; the worst gap is a different sans-serif face plus 1–3 px vertical drift that rasterizes as edge noise everywhere, and it is well structured with templates, though the top-level regions are absolutely placed.

top_defects.what: font-['Helvetica',Arial] renders a slightly different sans face than the reference's: glyph shapes and advances differ a little, so the heatmap outlines every word, even where lines wrap identically

top_defects.where: right column, "In the news" block and Kimi Antonelli photo
top_defects.what: heading band and bullets sit about 1.5 CSS px higher, the photo about 3 CSS px higher (starts at y≈1146 vs 1152 device px at display scale); the "Did you know ..." heading sits about 1 px lower; page tabs text is 1 px lower
border #a2a9b1, but the reference's input border is #72777d (measured), so the field reads lighter
meanDiff 10.4 (cells up to 24.9 in the lower right) comes from text anti-aliasing offsets and the photos shifted by a few pixels

top_defects.where: Header, Page tabs, Main page content, Appearance menu
top_defects.what: the four top-level regions and the header's children (menu, logo, search, user links) are absolutely positioned with pixel offsets instead of a flex header and a page grid; the content inside each region does flow
the four section headings (h2) repeat the same long class string, about 60 links repeat text-[#3366cc], and 237 arbitrary values stand in for tokens

strengths: Every text of the reference is present with identical line breaks (featured article, Help us improve, In the news, Appearance panel), including the diacritics in Święczkowski and Sochański

Box colors match the measured values: #f5fffa/#cef2e0 and #f5faff/#cedff2 columns, #cef2e0/#a3bfb1 and #cee0f2/#a3b0bf headings, #f9f9f9 banner; it uses the real wordmark, tagline, Codex icons, the three cropped photos and the blue new-feature dot
Templates drive the user links, view tabs, appearance groups and radio options (nested data), and the regions carry semantic tags and data-name labels
